title: Our services
subtitle: Integrated solutions for tax compliance and digital transformation — from invoicing to e-signature and ongoing support.
featuredSubtitle: Get a certified signature or seal certificate and connect it to the tax system to secure your documents quickly.

einvoicing.title: E-invoice & e-receipt
einvoicing.shortDescription: An integrated system for issuing electronic invoices and receipts with direct integration to the Egyptian Tax Authority.
einvoicing.detail: We prepare your company to issue e-invoices and e-receipts per ETA requirements: master data setup, portal connectivity, submission tracking, and legal signing via the signature agent. Built for teams that need both invoice and receipt flows with day-to-day compliance visibility.
bullets: Issue and track invoices and receipts

erp.title: Integrated ERP systems
erp.shortDescription: A comprehensive system to manage inventory, accounting, clients, and sales in one platform to ensure your organization's efficiency.
erp.detail: We design and deliver ERP solutions that connect inventory, accounting, customers, and sales in one platform, with reports that help leadership decide. The goal is less duplicate entry and a single data flow from the counter to financial reporting.

signature.title: E-signature & e-seal
signature.shortDescription: Certified solutions to link electronic signatures and seals with tax systems and secure your digital documents.
signature.detail: We guide you through issuing and activating a certified e-signature and e-seal, then linking them to tax systems and your digital documents. Signature (individuals/authorized signers) and seal (entities) stay one service — clearly separated on the service page.
bullets: Clear split between signature and seal
Link to tax systems and documents

consulting.title: Consulting & systems analysis
consulting.shortDescription: A thorough study and analysis of your work environment to identify the best technical solutions for your future needs.
consulting.detail: We start from your current processes and regulatory constraints, then recommend practical digital and tax-compliance solutions. Analysis covers system gaps, delivery priorities, and a measurable roadmap before you buy or build.

integration.title: Integration services
integration.shortDescription: Connecting our new systems with your existing software to ensure a seamless data flow across all company departments.
integration.detail: We connect DTS solutions (invoicing, POS, signature) to your existing stack through controlled interfaces and data flows. Departments share one source of truth without retyping, with monitoring and recovery when links fail.

projectManagement.title: Digital transformation project management
projectManagement.shortDescription: Professional management of the entire digital transformation project, from planning to final delivery and operation.
projectManagement.detail: We run the transformation from planning and scheduling through handover and go-live, with clear coordination between your teams and vendors. We track risks, milestones, and day-to-day impact so operations keep moving during the change.

training.title: Training & qualification
training.shortDescription: Customized training programs for your team to ensure maximum benefit from the new systems and improve performance.
training.detail: Hands-on training on new systems (invoicing, POS, signature, ERP) for users and managers. Live sessions plus quick reference materials so the team is confident from day one.
bullets: Practical sessions on the live system

support.title: Specialized technical support
support.shortDescription: We offer flexible and responsive technical support plans to ensure your business continuity without interruption.
support.detail: Flexible support plans covering daily incidents, updates, and compliance follow-up. Clear channels (phone, email, WhatsApp) and priority response suited to your operations — so invoicing and signature keep running.
